svg.title: Configured Store application dependencies
svg.desc: Application Gateway HTTPS enters store-front. HTTP catalog reads go to product-service; HTTP order submission goes to order-service, including virtual-customer. Order-service publishes AMQP to RabbitMQ; makeline initiates the broker connection and consumes messages, then writes order state over a MongoDB-compatible protocol to DocumentDB. Private store-admin reads product-service and makeline; virtual-worker calls makeline over HTTP. Seven Deployments and two ephemeral StatefulSets. Configured logical interactions, not captured traces.
